Our Services:Foundation Settlement Repair

We've been doing settlement repair for years and take pride in being a trusted partner to homeowners who need it done right the first time, and on schedule.

01

We're honest and we do things right.

We'll tell you plainly what your home needs, even if that's nothing. When repair is needed, we do it right the first time and stand behind the work.

02

Signs you need foundation repair

  • ★Diagonal drywall cracks off door and window corners
  • ★Stair-step cracking in brick veneer
  • ★Doors binding or out of square
  • ★Cracked floor tile following a single line
  • ★Gaps between walls and ceiling or trim
  • ★Floors that slope toward one corner
03

What causes settlement in Spring, TX

Expansive clay

Spring sits on clay soil that swells when wet and shrinks when dry. That movement pushes and drops the slab above it.

Drought summers

Long dry stretches pull moisture from under slab edges first, so corners and west- and south-facing walls tend to drop.

Creeks and a shallow water table

Homes near Spring Creek and Cypress Creek see wetter, softer soil that shifts more between seasons.

Mature trees

Oaks and pines in older neighborhoods like Champion Forest draw water from the clay near the foundation.

Poorly compacted fill

Some newer subdivisions were built on fill that was not compacted well, and slabs can settle within the first decade.

Plumbing leaks

Many 1970s and 80s homes still have cast-iron drains that leak under the slab and soften the soil.

04

How we fix it

  1. STEP 01
    Elevation survey

    Digital floor readings across the slab show where it has dropped and by how much.

  2. STEP 02
    Engineered pier plan

    A third-party structural engineer reviews pier count, spacing and depth.

  3. STEP 03
    Pilings pressed to refusal

    Concrete cylinders or steel pipe are driven hydraulically until the soil supports the load.

  4. STEP 04
    Controlled lift

    The slab is raised in small increments back toward level and re-surveyed.

  5. STEP 05
    Clean up and report

    Access holes are backfilled and compacted, and you get a pier log with every depth recorded.

06

FAQs

How deep do pressed pilings go in Spring?

Each piling is driven until it reaches refusal, the point where soil resistance supports the load. Depth varies by lot and is recorded for every pier.

Concrete or steel pilings?

Both are pressed to refusal. Steel reaches greater depth on lots with deep soft clay; concrete is common and cost-effective on typical Spring lots. The engineer specifies which.

How long does the repair take?

The repair itself usually takes one to three days. Add time for the engineer's review and any permit, which can take a week or two. We'll walk you through the full timeline up front.

Will my cracks close after leveling?

Finishes can shift as the structure moves. Many existing cracks close as the house returns toward level.

Is a permit required?

Many jurisdictions around Spring require one. We pull it and schedule any required inspection.
